conversations.content: How should the cover be oriented during installation?
Install the cover with the embossment facing out.
What procedure is shown for accessing the tail lights in 1988 models?
Unscrew screws and take tail lights out of tail panel.
What is the wire color code for the connection from FUSE 7 downward?
The wire color code from FUSE 7 downward is 1 VI/YL.
How do I fix a leaking O-ring in the guide flange that's causing oil on the clutch bell housing?
Replace O-ring part number 23 11 590.
If the transmission leaks between the front and rear sections, what's the likely cause?
A defective gasket is the cause of leaks between the front and rear sections.
What is the full description of the fuel system component 13 82?
Mixture and metering system, low-pressure reducer
Why does BMW specify that the wheel bearing must always be replaced during this procedure?
Because pulling off the drive flange will destroy the wheel bearing during the removal process.
Which components represent the front wheel signal sensors?
Components 362 (Signal sensor connection - front left) and 363 (Signal sensor - front left) represent the front wheel signal sensors.
Which transmission types use 22 Nm torque for the shift segment to shaft?
A4S 310R/A4S 310R
What does callout number 7 represent?
Callout number 7 represents the trailing arm eye.
What are the four different hole sizes that need to be punched and drilled?
A = 6.2 mm (0.244 inch), B = 8.5 mm (0.335 inch), C = 9.0 mm (0.354 inch), and D = 6.5 mm (0.256 inch) diameter.
What should you always disconnect when working on the electrical system for TCI and DME?
Always disconnect battery or interrupt power supply to ignition control unit and ignition coil when working on the electrical system.
What is the connector designation for the Control Unit / Impact Switch?
The connector designation is 730 51 B23.
How many different torque values are specified for the F clutch Torx screws across different transmission types?
Two different torque values: 10 Nm for 4HP-22/4HP-24 transmissions and 23 Nm for A5S 560Z transmission.
What reference should I check for resistance specifications?
See Specifications and Nominal Value Microfiche.
How should the striker bolts be tightened during installation?
Tighten striker bolts lightly in middle position.
What steps are required to access the car jack when removing the trunk trim panel on the left side wall?
Remove floor mat, unscrew screw, turn up lock and take out the car jack.
What is the maximum settle pressure for tire mounting?
The maximum settle pressure is 4.0 bar (57 psi).
What should I do if the clutch grabs but the liner is not as specified?
Replace drive plate 21 21 000.
What torque specification is required for the oil pump cover bolts?
10 Nm using M6 screws
What occurs with the antenna when switching off the radio?
Antenna will run in when switching off the radio.
How do you correct insufficient clutch pedal travel?
Check pedal travel and adjust if necessary. Remove excessively thick floor mats. Floor clutch pedal when changing gear 35 31 000.
What connector designation is shown for the accessory connection point?
The accessory connection point is designated as C302 (ACCESSORY CONNECTOR).
How should the speaker wires be routed from the front?
Route speaker wires from front along standard wire harness to places of speaker installation.
What important step must be done between layers when building up the laminate?
Remove foils between layers and harden the laminate with an ultraviolet lamp.
For super unleaded fuel (98 NORM), what are the terminal positions for both connectors 10 and 28?
Terminal 10: a massa (to ground), Terminal 28: a massa (to ground)
What are the requirements before checking front brake disc runout?
The requirement is that wheel bearings must be okay before performing the runout check.
What is the amperage rating of fuse 4 that supplies the glove box light?
Fuse 4 is rated at 15 AMP.
What must be removed before pulling out the ball bearing?
The clutch must be removed (see section 21 21 000) before pulling out the ball bearing.
What causes the ABS control lamp to stay on at high engine speed of a stopped car or longer lasting ABS control after stopping the car?
The cause is dispersion in sensor wire. Check routing of wires for ABS sensors.
What important caution is given when cutting off the side panel?
Caution! Don't cut through guide plate for forced air extraction.
What resistance values should I see when testing the drive switch through ground between pin 5 (brown) and pin 4 (green/black)?
Eye pulled out: Ω ≈ 0 (approximately zero ohms), Eye pushed into drive: Ω ≈ ∞ (approximately infinite ohms).
What tool is needed to pry the cover strip out of clamps on the left door beam for two door cars?
A screwdriver is needed to pry the cover strip out of clamps on the left door beam.
Why is there a caution about testing only one wheel on the brake test stand?
If only one wheel turns during test on brake test stand, viscous lock is subjected to strong loads which could lead to destruction due to excessive heat.
What callout numbers are located near the front wheel area?
Callout numbers 1 and 2 are located near the front wheel area.
What resistance should socket 5 (brown) on the plug show when testing trunk lid drive against vehicle ground?
Resistance should be 0 Ω (zero ohms).
Which pins control the driver's and passenger's door locks?
Pins 6 and 7 control the driver's and passenger's doors - pin 6 is Inlet I UNLOCKED and pin 7 is Inlet I LOCKED.
What connector number is associated with the chime module circuit?
The chime module circuit is associated with connector C103.
How do I fix a clutch that slips due to insufficient contact pressure?
Replace clutch 21 21 000.
Which diagram illustrates the hole drilling process?
Diagram 30 41 147 shows the drilling of holes for plug spot welding in the rear mating surface.
For four cylinder models, what component needs to be unscrewed on the front axle carrier?
For four cylinder models, unscrew the engine damper on the front axle carrier.
What relays are shown at the bottom right of the diagram?
The diagram shows the Main relay and Fuel pump relay at the bottom right, which control power distribution to the fuel system and other components.
What is the proper installation sequence for the expander rivet and plug?
First insert the plug and then press in the expander rivet.
What component is labeled as number 8 in this BMW 318i coolant circuit?
Number 8 identifies the thermostat.
What transmission types use M8 Torx screws for the F clutch?
A5S 560Z transmission uses M8 Torx screws.
What type of signal pattern should appear on the oscilloscope when testing the pulse sender?
The illustrated signal should appear in the oscilloscope screen showing a square wave pattern when the engine is cranked with the starting motor.
How should the shaft be driven in during installation?
Drive in shaft partially with bore facing up, slide on the guide sprocket, then drive in shaft against the stop.
Under what conditions does fuse 19 receive power?
Fuse 19 is hot in run only from unloader relay K7.
What is the multimeter test specification for the pulse sender?
Disconnect plug and measure resistance between pins 1 and 2. The resistance should be 520 ohms ± 5%. Perform insulation test which should be greater than 100 k-ohms.
What color wire should I check for ground on the control unit?
Check the brown wire (pin 4) for ground on the control unit.
What important safety consideration is mentioned regarding the chemical reaction during UV lamp treatment?
Chemical reaction produces heat, which could lead to self-destruction of the laminate. If necessary, interrupt the ultraviolet lamp treatment occasionally.
What is the proper technique for guiding the knife during windshield removal?
Guide traverse of knife parallel to window and guide the knife between the body and window carefully.
What should I do if socket 5 (brown) doesn't show the correct resistance to ground?
Break in ground to drive - repair. Also refer to connection on central ground point behind instrument panel at bottom left.
On which pages are the component location views documented?
Component location views are documented on pages 7000-0.
What torque specification is mentioned for the 4-door installation?
Tightening torque (with asterisk indicating to see specifications).
What torque value should be applied to the solid aluminum screw on the oil filter drain plug?
The solid aluminum screw should be torqued to 10 Nm using an M21 screw type.
Where should the white wire be plugged in the automatic antenna connection?
Plug white wire in "automatic antenna" connection and antenna wire (1) in jack of radio.
Where should the lockplate be positioned once installed?
The lockplate should be locked in the groove.
What is the screw size and torque specification for the plug component 9AZ?
M18 screw size with 43 Nm torque
What is the 6.5×14 cross spoke alloys for the BMW E30 320is?
6.5×14 bottlecap alloys
For stop light switches on 1987 and later models, where should you look for adjustment information?
For stop light switches since 1987 models, adjustment information can be found in Group 61.
Which component uses a 5/16 inch screw in the Interior Shift Elements section?
The detent spring on shift unit for A4S 270R/A4S 310R transmissions
Which callout numbers are positioned along the roofline of the vehicle?
Callout numbers 10, 11, 12, 13, 14, 15, and 16 are positioned along the roofline of the vehicle.
What page covers troubleshooting for the front axle?
Front axle troubleshooting information is covered on page 31-18.
Which gear selector rods need to be installed with selector forks?
Install 3rd/4th gear selector fork and 1st/2nd as well as 5th/reverse gear selector rods with selector forks.
What is the final step if the wire from bulb tester terminal KKL to check control terminal KKL is faulty?
If the wire from bulb tester terminal KKL to check control terminal KKL is not okay, check or replace the wire, then check plug connections on check control and replace the check control.
What are the components in the installed order list for the seat belt assembly?
1 Bolt, 2 Washer (plastic), 3 Upper strap, 4 Washer (plastic), 5 Washers (two), with tightening torque specified.
What critical positioning requirement is noted for the dial gage when measuring rim well runout?
The dial gage must be perpendicular to the rim well.
What type of documentation or labels are visible with the bearing component?
BMW parts packaging labels and what appears to be shipping or parts documentation
What component is located in position K10?
K10 is the Wiper Control Unit
What is the torque range for M10 screws used on the bearing on countershaft across different transmission types?
The torque range is 30 Nm to 90 Nm depending on the transmission type.
What three input signals does the service interval processor receive?
The service interval processor receives engine speed input, engine temperature input, and vehicle speed input.
What wire colors are used for the connections from the Active Check Control Units to the Light Switch Details?
The wire colors are 1 GY/YL, .5 GY/YL, and 1 GY/MT for the left unit, and .75 GY/RD for the right unit connections.
Which has a higher torque specification: M6 10.9 or M7 8.8 screws?
M7 8.8 screws have a higher torque specification at 14.8 Nm compared to M6 10.9 at 14.0 Nm
What should be checked during installation of the propeller shaft cap?
Check seals on propeller shaft and power divider during installation.
Which connections should the oscilloscope be connected to for pulse sender testing?
Connect oscilloscope on connections 1 and 2 of pulse sender (M 22/23).
What ignition switch position is required for both voltage tests?
The ignition switch must be in the RUN position.
What are the wire colors for the self-diagnosis transmitting lead (RXD)?
White/yellow
What should be done if the air conditioner does not have moisture or leak issues?
If the pressure does not rise, switch off the vacuum pump.
How is the roller assembly described in terms of its construction?
It consists of a main shaft roller assembly with an inner sleeve and outer race.
What connector pins are shown in the middle section labeled as 30, 31, 31b, 30a, 86?
The connector in the middle section shows pins 30, 31, 31b, 30a, and 86.
What wire color and size is used for the SRS Connector on pin 6?
Pin 6 uses a size .5 WT/BK (white/black) wire for the SRS Connector.
What is the main action required for the spot welds throughout this procedure?
Make spot welding accessible and drill out spot welds.
What voltage should you measure between pins 2 (BK/VI) and Ground in the A/C select switch test?
Battery voltage.
If the ABS control lamp stays on for 15 to 20 seconds after starting the engine while the car is stopped and engine running at idle speed, what could be the cause?
The cause is a break in the 'idle speed boost' current path. Check for a break in connection between ABS wire harness plug pin 3 and solenoid ground.
What indicates that the battery is charged insufficiently with charge indicator lamp off while engine running?

Connect BMW service test unit and perform engine test (P 012). If not okay, check battery and replace if necessary. Check power drain with equipment switched off. If okay, check regulating voltage and charging current with equipment on too low.
What are the two main components that make up this roller assembly?
The inner sleeve and outer race.
Which plug is specifically identified as gray in color?
The Reference mark plug, labeled as number 4, is specifically identified as gray in color.
Where is the hydraulic unit located and what is its purpose?

The hydraulic unit is located in the engine compartment and was added to the conventional brake system. To control the brake pressure in the wheel brake cylinders, the brake hydraulic unit has the three-way valves which permit three brake pressure conditions.
What procedure is being described in section 2 of this page?
Block Distance Adjustment from Ring Gear and Pinion.
How do the speed sensors work to detect wheel movement?

Each speed sensor has a gear wheel, which runs past the permanently magnetized edge of the speed sensor and is installed in the wheel hub. The rotary motion of the wheels is recorded by inductive sensors and an electric signal is sent to the electronic control unit.
What should be done after loosing the balls, springs and slides in step 8?
Installation: Replace pin.
What should be done to the air conditioning system before removing the heater?
Discharge pressure in air conditioner with help of valve core remover.
What are the three main steps shown in the ball bearing replacement procedure?

The three steps are: pulling off the bearing with Special Tool 00 7 500, replacing the cover if damaged during bearing removal, and checking washer location with collar facing the bearing during installation.
What should you do in step 1 of the troubleshooting procedure?
In step 1, you should operate the problem circuit to check the accuracy of the complaint and note the symptoms of the inoperative circuit.
What is the installation instruction for the trim?
Paste trim during installation.
Where can additional specifications for this component be found?
Additional specifications can be found in the Specifications section, as indicated by the note at the bottom of the page.
What adjustment options are available for achieving proper guide sleeve fit?
Circlips are available from Parts in different thicknesses to achieve proper adjustment of the guide sleeve to be without play.
What preliminary steps must be completed before checking wheel rim runout?
Remove wheel (see 36 10 300), take tire off wheel rim, remove old balance weights, and remove dirt on rim well and rim flange.
What size should hole D be drilled to?
Hole D should be drilled to 6.5 mm (0.256 inch) diameter.
What does the abbreviation 'GN' represent in the wire insulation color codes?
According to the wire insulation abbreviations chart, 'GN' represents GREEN.
How should you handle the fuel intake when removing the intank pump?
Turn fuel intake counterclockwise and pull out carefully.
What is the important rule about grinding brake discs?
Always fine grind both sides of both brake discs on one axle. After machining to minimum thickness, install only one more set of brake pads.
What is the critical installation requirement for the engine mount turning lock?
The engine mount turning lock (1) must engage in the bore and be torqued to specification.
What did the bearing shop say about the bearing size?
The bearing shop told them it was an unusual size and that it was a BMW NLA (No Longer Available) part.
Which fuse protects the auto-charging flashlight circuit and what is its rating?
Fuse 21 protects the auto-charging flashlight circuit and is rated at 7.5 AMP.
Where should the red charging hose be connected?
Connect red charging hose (1) on the high pressure side (thin pipe or drier) of the air conditioner.
How do I test the bulb tester output terminals?
Check for voltage on bulb tester outlet terminals KAL and KAR. If there's no voltage, replace the bulb tester.
What year marks the change in expansion tank removal procedure?
1988 models introduced a different procedure that requires unscrewing a bolt before removing the expansion tank.
What should be done to welding spots before removing the tail panel?
Drill off welding spots before taking off the tail panel.
What protective equipment is required when working on an air conditioner?
Wear protective clothing! Absolute cleanliness is required for the performance of work on an air conditioner.
What is the reference number for the image showing the bolt unscrewing procedure?
The reference number is 30 62 012.
What reference number is associated with the detailed cross-section drawing?
The cross-section drawing is referenced as 30 11 125.
Where can I find information about the basic throttle setting procedure?
What is the oil temp indicator?
The oil temp indicator for the BMW E30 320is is Oil temp indicator .
What happened when getting 2nd gear off?
Getting 2nd gear off managed to 'loose' a ball bearing from the syncro hub never to be found again.
What is the sequence for disconnecting the control unit plugs?
First push back retainer (1), then pull off multiple pin plug (2) on control unit, then disconnect plug (3).
What is the highest torque value specified in the Interior Shift Elements section?
35 Nm for the A5S 300J transmission shift segment to shaft
What does the '+BS' marking indicate in the diagram?
The '+BS' marking indicates the Brake light switch according to the legend.
What should be checked in the sprocket during installation?
Check needle sleeve in sprocket, replacing if necessary.
What are the possible causes if my clutch is slipping?

Clutch slipping can be caused by: insufficient clutch contact pressure, seriously worn liner, liner splattered with oil from transmission or crankshaft seal faults, overheated clutch, or clutch not being an original BMW part.
Can you disconnect the battery while the engine is running?
Never disconnect the battery or leads on the alternator and starter while engine is running.
What wires should I check if the system doesn't unlock or lock after pulling off the plug on drive?
Check for connection between pin 8 (green/black) or pin 9 (yellow/black) on control unit with connected plug and ground.
How do you access the headlight bulbs according to the first image?
Open turning lock and lift out cover, then compress clips and lift out plug.
What is the difference in the cover strip removal procedure between two door and four door cars?
For two door cars, pry cover strip out of clamps on left door beam only. For four door cars, pry cover strips out of clamps on left front and rear door beams.
What procedure is specified for the outside edge of the entrance?
Braze entrance on outside edge.
What page number is shown at the top of this diagram?
The page number shown is 64-2.
What's the corrective action if the distributor cap or rotor fails inspection?
Replace distributor cap and/or rotor.
Which component uses M6 screws in the manual transmission case and cover assembly?
Both the bearing bracket on rear section of case and mounting tabs for sealing cover use M6 screws.
What condition is described in the text below the image?
Black grime was found everywhere even though the oil seemed cleanish.
Which camshaft components use the same M6 screw size?
Both the bearing flange on engine block and the reversing rail on engine block use M6 screws, both requiring 13 Nm torque.
What is the installation procedure for holders?
Insert new holders and press in expansion rivets.
What should be done with the originally installed shim during reassembly?
Install drive set with the originally installed shim (A), e.g. A = 1.80 mm (0.071"), and bolt.
What diagram number shows the procedure for removing the plug cartridge from its housing?
Diagram 28 65 183 shows the procedure for pulling the plug cartridge (1) out of housing (2).
What wire color indicates the burglar alarm signal?
Black/violet
What tool is mentioned for marking hole centers during panel replacement?
A drilling template is used - hold it on the edge, paste it along the wheel house contour, punch mark centers of holes, then pull off drilling template.
What sound indicates that basic clearance is being reached during parking brake adjustment?
A click will be heard on the rear wheel brakes until reaching the basic clearance.
What electrical connections need to be disconnected for heater removal?
Disconnect plugs (1) connecting heater wire harness and car wire harness.
What screw size and torque are specified for the intermediate plate on intermediate housing?
5/16" screws with 25 Nm torque
What is the first step in the output flange installation procedure?
The first step is to push or drive on the output flange.
Which section of the manual contains these M8 and M8x1 torque specifications?
Section 00-4 General Instructions
What must be checked and possibly replaced during installation?
Check rubber mount (4), replacing if necessary. Replace seals.
Which circuits are hot at all times according to the diagram?
The cigar lighter circuit (fuse 28) and the auto-charging flashlight circuit (fuse 21) are hot at all times.
What precaution should be taken to protect the vehicle body during windshield removal?
Protect body with tape.
What's the correction if there's a bearing fault in the crankshaft for transmission input shaft?
Replace bearing in crankshaft 11 21 571.
What is illustrated in diagram 30 51 583?
Diagram 30 51 583 shows the striker installation with arrows indicating the tightening direction and door handle operation.
In the distributor housing diagram, what does callout number 4 indicate?
Callout number 4 indicates the distributor rotor that needs to be unscrewed.
What component is labeled as item 1 in the wire removal procedure (diagram 28 65 186)?
Item 1 indicates the plug receptacle or connector where the wire is being removed from.
What are the possible causes when the transmission shifts hard or makes sticking and scratching noises?

The causes include insufficient clutch release due to inadequate pedal travel, worn drive plate, seized liner on flywheel, seized drive plate on transmission input shaft, defective bearing for transmission input shaft in crankshaft, air in clutch hydraulic system, thick viscous transmission oil, damaged bushes for selector rod arrest, excessive play in shift lever mount, worn selector forks, or worn sliding sleeve.
What voltage should be checked on the electric fuel pump connections?
Check voltage (approx. 12 V) on connections of electric fuel pump (M 01).
What is the first step when removing the brake system components?
Unscrew brake caliper and suspend from body on a piece of wire, ensuring brake line remains connected.
What components are identified by callout numbers 23 1 200 and 23 1 210 in the top diagram?
23 1 200 identifies the torque application tool and 23 1 210 identifies the collar nut tightening tool.
Which connector number is associated with the instrument cluster?
Connector C101 is associated with the instrument cluster printed circuit.
What are the steps to remove the radiator grill center section?
Open engine hood, remove clamps, and remove grill.
What fuse positions are shown in the lower row of the power distribution box?
The lower row shows fuse positions 16 through 30
What components need to be removed to access the stirrup?
Unscrew the screw and take off the stirrup.
What should you do if both voltages are correct in the Control Switches test?
If both voltages are correct, replace the Control Switches.
What orientation should the collar have relative to the bearing during installation?
The collar should face the bearing during installation.
What is the main procedure described in section 23 12 053?
Section 23 12 053 describes replacing the radial oil seal for the output flange.
What is the source of supply for tire mounting paste?
The source of supply for tire mounting paste is HWB.
What equipment is required to properly check wheel rim runout?
A suitable center of pertinent balancing machine and dial gage equipment are required.
What is the reference number shown at the bottom left of the left image?
The reference number shown is 30 31 551.
What is the tightening torque for front brake disc installation?
The installation requires tightening torque as specified, but the exact value is referenced to specifications at the bottom of the page.
What component is labeled 31 5 030 in the left side image?
31 5 030 is a special tool used for driving in the shaft seal.
What should I do if there's no voltage at the cold start valve?
Provide power supply, check wire with ohmmeter (see wiring diagram).
Which components in this section use the same 5.0 Nm torque specification?
The angle impulse sensor on cylinder head and the crankshaft sensor on timing case cover both use 5.0 Nm (ft. lbs.)
What is the coupe 2-door(ak95)?
The coupe 2-door(ak95) for the BMW E30 320is is Sedan 4-door(AC95) .
What is the 03/88 - 11/90 for the BMW E30 320is?
What causes clutch noise due to unbalanced clutch and drive plate?
Excessive unbalance of clutch and drive plate causes clutch noise.
What is the main engine section number that contains this water pump torque specification information?
11 - 30 Engine
What should I do if the drive switch doesn't show the correct resistance values?
Replace drive.
What is the maximum power rating for component 371?
The maximum power rating for component 371 is 3W.
What temperature range in Celsius corresponds to the switching operation?
The switch operates between -8°C and 4°C, going from 0 ohms below -8°C to infinite ohms above 4°C.
What important warning is given about wheel mounting?
Avoid clamping errors when mounting wheel afterwards - see 36 10 508.
What component needs to be pulled out of the housing according to diagram 28 65 183?
Pull plug cartridge (1) out of housing (2).
What should be done if there are leaks in the throttle housing?
Eliminate leaks if applicable.
What does callout number 43 indicate in the drive pinion diagram?
Callout number 43 indicates the pair code (P) that is electrically inscribed on the drive pinion, which must match the pair code on the ring gear.
What type of specifications would I find in this section?
This section contains tightening torque specifications for various components and fasteners.
What component is identified by callout number 33 1307 in the diagrams?
Callout number 33 1307 identifies Special Tool 33 1 307 used in the bearing removal process.
What is visible on the inner surface of the component?
Splined teeth are visible on the inner surface of the synchro ring.
What is the maximum allowable vacuum difference when adjusting throttle valve necks?
The maximum vacuum difference is 5 mbar when adjusting each throttle valve neck to the same intake pipe vacuum.
What components are connected with charging valve 1 according to the upper right image?
Connect the refrigerant cylinder (2) and charging hose (16) with charging valve (1). Charging valve (1) remains connected until the charging cylinder has been filled.
What component is referenced as 1AZ in the torque specifications?
Intake manifold on cylinder head
What colors are shown for the service interval display indicator?
The service interval display shows GREEN, YELLOW, and RED colors as indicated in the diagram.
What needs to be removed before replacing the sprocket set?
Remove oil pump drive chain (see 11 41 151), unscrew shaft bolt (1) and take off oil pipe (2).
What do I do if the ground wires to the license plate lights are faulty?
If ground wires to license plate lights are not okay, make ground connections and replace the light bulbs.
What components need to be removed to access the bumper mounting bolts?
Lift out clips and remove rubber guard to access the mounting area.
What torque value should be applied to the hollow bolt for the oil line for camshaft lubrication on cylinder head?
The hollow bolt for the oil line for camshaft lubrication on cylinder head (7AZ) should be torqued to 10 Nm using an M8x1 screw for all types.
Is it possible to remove the drive flange without damaging the wheel bearing?
No, pulling off the drive flange will destroy the wheel bearing, which must always be replaced.
What components are shown being removed in step 9?
Operating sleeve and fifth gear selector fork, with selector rod (9) being pulled out forward.
Where is the central ground point located that I should refer to?
The central ground point is located behind the instrument panel at the bottom left.
Why is it important not to turn the propeller shaft in the slide during hard movement?
The propeller shaft was balanced in assembled state and must not be turned in the slide. The position of propeller shaft sections must be marked to each other.
What maintenance should be performed on the air cleaner filter element?
Replace a dirty air cleaner filter element.
What voltage should be present in socket 3 (red/black) of the driver's door/body plug?
There should be voltage greater than 11V in socket 3 (red/black) of the driver's door/body plug.
What are the main components of the ABS system?
The ABS consists of a control unit, hydraulic unit, speed sensors and a wire harness.
What are the different torque values for the plug for chain tensioner depending on engine type?
For M50/S50 US engines: 50 Nm with M22 x 1.5 screw. For all other engines: 40 Nm with M22 x 1.5 screw.
Which special tools are required when applying them to hold the output flange?
Special Tool 23 1 200 is applied, and the output flange is held with Special Tool 23 0 020.
What is required for push rod adjustment according to the synchronization section?
Push rod adjustment must be correct, referencing Removing and Installing Throttle Valve Housing section 13 54 030.
What are the three brake pressure phases that the hydraulic unit controls?

Pressure build-up, pressure holding and pressure drop. These three pressure phases adapt themselves in the sequences and length to the requirements of the desired control characteristic and power flow between the road surface and tyre.
What warning is given about using an ohmmeter on solid-state components?
Do not use an ohmmeter on solid-state components. The voltage that the ohmmeter applies to the circuit could damage these components.
Can the radio be turned on when the ignition key is in position "0"?
No, radio cannot be turned on when ignition key is turned to position "0".
How do you remove the bumper after unscrew the bolts?
Unscrew bolts and pull bumper forward.
What component is identified as number 11 in the crankshaft survey diagram?
Component number 11 in the crankshaft survey is the Crankshaft.
What is component 375 according to the wiring diagram legend?
Component 375 is the Acceleration transmitter according to the legend.
What is the purpose of clamping the differential in aluminum jaws?
The differential should be clamped in a vise fitted with aluminum jaws to securely hold it while unscrewing the bolts during disassembly.
What should be checked regarding the stop lights after installation?
The function of the stop lights should be checked after installation.
What does 'See 1' refer to in the diagnosis column of the voltage test table?
See 1 refers to the first diagnostic step in the sequence for troubleshooting when the voltage measurement is incorrect.
What break time is required between each viscous lock test?
A break of at least 30 minutes is required after each test. This time applies to both cold and warm-run cars.
What component is shown being unscrewed in the bottom diagram?
The bottom diagram shows unscrewing a screw as part of the absorber removal process.
What is item 5 in the sound system layout?
Speaker balance control
What is the wire color designation for the connection to position 13 of the instrument cluster?
The wire connecting to position 13 of the instrument cluster is .5 VI/NT (violet/natural).
What does callout number 1 indicate in the engine mount diagram?
Callout number 1 indicates the engine mount turning lock that must engage in the bore during installation.
What installation note is given for the housing bolt?
Install longer bolt for the ground lead correctly during installation.
How many mounting points are visible on the differential housing?
Multiple bolt holes and mounting points are visible around the perimeter of the differential housing for securing it in the transmission case.
Where can I find the procedure for removing and installing the coil spring for front spring strut?
The procedure for removing and installing the coil spring for front spring strut is located on page 31-16.
If the clutch rivets are loose and causing noise, what's the fix?
Replace clutch 21 21 000.
What are the 'B' valve seat width specifications for both intake and exhaust valves?
The 'B' intake valve seat width is 1.2 ± 0.1 mm (0.047 ± 0.004 inches) and the 'B' exhaust valve seat width is 1.4 ± 0.1 mm (0.055 ± 0.004 inches).
How do you disconnect the side trim panel?
Disconnect the side trim panel by removing 3 clips and pull up out of clamps.
What does callout number 12 represent in the coolant system?
Callout number 12 represents the heater feed.
What is the function of component 372?
Component 372 is the Idle enrichment according to the legend.
What happens when you press the button during the fuel pump delivery rate test?
When you press the button, the fuel pump runs and you can check the delivery rate.
What should be done to the front end of the propeller shaft and center mount before replacing the radial oil seal?
